headline: Sensex ends flat, Nifty gains as metals shine despite Fed concerns
why: FII outflows hit a 7-week peak of $496 million due to post-Fed market reallocation.
US Treasury yields rose as global markets weighed the outlook for interest rate hikes.
Analysts expect RBI may deliver up to two rate hikes by CY 2026.
IT sector faced selling pressure ahead of the upcoming US Federal Reserve decision.
whatHappening: Nifty 50 crossed 23,200 while Sensex closed slightly lower by 22 points.
Metals and FMCG sectors saw strong buying, with smallcaps surging nearly 1.8%.
NSE's ₹22,569-crore IPO reached full subscription on its second day of bidding.
Maruti Suzuki launched automatic S-CNG variants for Swift, Dzire, and Baleno.

summary: Indian equity markets closed on a mixed note with Nifty gaining to cross 23,200 while Sensex dipped marginally by 22 points. Sectoral performance saw strong support from Metals and FMCG, while IT stocks pulled the market down ahead of the US Fed meeting. Meanwhile, primary market momentum continued as NSE's mega IPO got fully subscribed on Day 2.
